title: The Goatem of Undying
description: Be the GOAT and turn your totem into... a goat!
body:
[Hermitcraft](https://hermitcraft.com/) Season 8 was a weird season... they had a boatem pole... and a goatem pole. ...well that inspired me to make...
## The Goatem of Undying
It's a retextured Totem of Undying to resemble a goat!
You like goats? It's a must-use!

![It's the totem... but a goat.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ed987127c5558ff65fce2410f6e3afa8fb6eca9_0.webp)
